entities.summary: Dimitar D. Sasselov is a Bulgarian astronomer based in the United States. He is a Professor of Astronomy at Harvard University and director of the Harvard Origins of Life Initiative. In 2002, Sasselov led a team that discovered the most distant planet in the Milky Way known at the time. Dimitar Sasselov was a scientists & inventors from Nesebar (b. 1961-08-15, Nesebar). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
